name: litex-basics-api-mini
notes: Mini suite for pure-API skill smoke. Expect a single ```litex block with exactly the requested declaration(s).

tasks.name: points
tasks.prompt_zh: 用 Litex 定义平面点集 points 为实数有序对的笛卡尔积。只输出定义本身。
tasks.prompt_en: Define the plane point set `points` as the Cartesian product of the reals with itself. Output only the Litex definition.

tasks.name: vec
tasks.prompt_zh: 定义函数 vec(A,B)：A、B 属于 cart(R,R)，返回从 A 到 B 的位移向量，坐标用一元函数应用写出。只输出定义。
tasks.prompt_en: Define `vec(A, B)` for `A, B` in `cart(R, R)` as the displacement from A to B. Use one-based coordinate applications. Output only the definition.

tasks.name: pair_coords
tasks.prompt_zh: 引入 p = (2, 3) 属于 cart(R,R)，并检查 p 的两个坐标分别等于 2 和 3。只输出这三行。
tasks.prompt_en: Introduce `p = (2, 3)` in `cart(R, R)` and check both coordinates equal 2 and 3. Output only those three lines.

tasks.name: reciprocal
tasks.prompt_zh: 定义非零实数上的倒数函数 reciprocal。只输出 have fn 定义。
tasks.prompt_en: Define the reciprocal function on nonzero reals. Output only the `have fn` definition.

tasks.name: finite_set
tasks.prompt_zh: 定义有限集 S = {1, 2}，并断言 1 属于 S。只输出这两行。
tasks.prompt_en: Define the finite set `S = {1, 2}` and assert that 1 is a member of S. Output only those two lines.
